title: Migraine-prone today?
caption: Headache threshold lower today? The day has a slight wobble, and focus may come in short bursts. Dim your screens, relax your jaw and neck, use slow breathing, and work in small chunks with breaks—save the heavy lifts for later if you can.
snapshot: Geomagnetic activity is in the unsettled range. The solar wind looks normal. The magnetic field has leaned south. No solar flares were noted, and a couple recent eruptions in the Sun’s atmosphere are background only right now.
affects: Some may notice head pressure or a lower threshold for headache when the field leans south. Focus can come in shorter stretches. Energy may feel uneven at times, then settle. Not everyone feels this; local weather, air, and stress can matter more.
playbook:
- Ease screen glare and lower brightness
- Gentle neck and jaw stretch, slow breathing
- Sip water and add a salty snack if needed
- Work in short runs with small breaks
- Check local air, storms, smoke, or allergens
